About us

A trusted name for quality vehicles in Zimbabwe

Sam Sangaree Quality Cars ZW buys and sells vehicles, trucks and equipment across Zimbabwe. Every listing is photographed, priced openly and available to view on request, so you know what you are getting before you visit.

Whether you want a family SUV, a work truck, a fuel tanker or you are ready to sell what you own, you deal directly with us and get a straight answer.

FAQ

Common questions

Are the prices listed final?

Prices are in US dollars and shown as listed. Message us to confirm availability and discuss the deal.

Can I view a vehicle before buying?

Yes. Send us a message to arrange a viewing and test drive at a time that suits you.

Do you buy my car?

Yes. We buy cars and trucks. Send photos and details on WhatsApp and we will come back with an offer.

Can you sell my vehicle for me?

Yes. We list and sell vehicles and equipment on your behalf and aim for the best price, faster.

How do I reach you?

Call or WhatsApp +263 77 486 7248. You can also message us from any listing on this site.
